animations.name: impact
animations.description: Nonlethal or warning-time cosmetic vibration; returns to base. No door opens.

animations.name: dent
animations.description: Final cosmetic crease. LoopOnce + clampWhenFinished after authoritative breach, then fade to black.

animations.name: fault_01
animations.description: Loop only while unit 1 has an active fault; stop/reset when silenced. Light/noise remain game-controlled.

animations.name: fault_02
animations.description: Loop only while unit 2 has an active fault; stop/reset when silenced. Light/noise remain game-controlled.

animations.name: fault_03
animations.description: Loop only while unit 3 has an active fault; stop/reset when silenced. Light/noise remain game-controlled.

animations.name: fault_04
animations.description: Loop only while unit 4 has an active fault; stop/reset when silenced. Light/noise remain game-controlled.

animations.name: flip_off
animations.description: Cosmetic on→off lever motion; power state is code-authoritative.

animations.name: flip_on
animations.description: Cosmetic off→on lever motion; fixed key action remains usable in blackout.

animations.name: idle
animations.description: Subtle CCTV-only silhouette motion; no world movement.

animations.name: listen
animations.description: Feed-only listening tilt, synchronized to an eligible observed event.

animations.name: recoil
animations.description: Brief camera interruption silhouette movement; never an interior death reveal.
